title: The Five Kings in the Cave at Makkedah
description: The five Amorite kings fled and hid in the cave at Makkedah. Joshua ordered large stones rolled to block the entrance and set guards, while the army pursued the enemy. After the victory, the kings were brought forward, and the commanders placed their feet on their necks. Joshua struck them down, hung them on five trees until evening, and threw them into the cave with large stones blocking the entrance [ref:Jos 10:16-27|Joshua 10:16-27].
